summary: Verified bug fix: planning teams + quick-tasks are now shared server-side across admins instead of per-browser/per-user. 8/8 backend tests passed. Frontend Calendar (/calendar) loads team columns from GET /api/planning-teams, adds a team via UI (data-testids add-team-btn, new-team-name-input, confirm-add-team-btn) which PUTs to backend and persists across reloads. No regressions on agenda views, unassigned tasks banner, 'Taak toevoegen' button. Cleanup performed (planning_config doc deleted, test quick-task removed).
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/planning-teams accepts an empty teams list and stores it (sets is_default=false). After such a save, GET returns {teams:[], is_default:false} which would render no team columns in the UI. Consider guarding against empty list in the endpoint or in the frontend saveTeams() to avoid an empty board state.

There is no API to truly delete the planning_config doc; testing required direct DB cleanup. Consider a DELETE /api/planning-teams (admin) that removes the doc and restores defaults, useful for resetting.
/app/frontend/src/pages/CalendarPage.js is 1571 lines - exceeds 700 line guideline. Consider splitting into smaller components (TeamColumns, AgendaView, AddTeamCard, etc).

Quick-tasks endpoints (POST/PUT/DELETE) properly enforce admin role; GET allows any authenticated user. That matches the shared design intent. user_id is still stored on the doc on create, which is fine for audit but no longer used for filtering.
test_credentials: Admin: liam / Liammail123 via POST /api/auth/admin/login (session_token field).
seed_data_creation: Created and then DELETED: planning_config doc {id:'teams'} (used for shared-team verification) and one TEST_QT quick task. Final DB state: planning_config doc removed (so GET returns defaults again); quick_tasks unchanged (2 pre-existing tasks remain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_planning_teams_quick_tasks.py covers GET/PUT planning-teams (defaults, sharing across admins, auth, whitespace trimming) and quick-tasks (create→get→update→delete by id only). Frontend uses data-testids: add-team-btn, new-team-name-input, confirm-add-team-btn, team-card-{name}. localStorage keys: auth_token + session_token. No mocks in this flow.
rca of the issue: Original bug: planning teams were stored only in browser localStorage and quick-tasks were filtered by user_id, so each admin saw a private board. Fix: server-side planning_config collection with shared GET/PUT and quick-tasks endpoints returning/editing all tasks by id alone. Verified both pieces by reading the server-side data through one token and confirming the same data is returned on subsequent fetches (server-side state, not browser-side).
